answers.how: The truck is approximately 240 pixels long and moves about 279 pixels/s. Its length is 240 × 11.18 / 279 ≈ 9.6 m.
The truck's full width is approximately 85 pixels. Using the motion-derived scale, 85 × 11.18 / 279 ≈ 3.4 m.
The truck moves straight at 11.18 m/s for 1.0 − 0.5 = 0.5 s, giving a displacement of 5.59 m.
